generatedAt.description: When the report was produced. `violations`, `files` and `findings` are counted at this moment.

cliVersion.description: The Taskless CLI version that produced the report.

retention.description: Requested retention: `public` keeps the report 183 days and may name the repository in analytics; absent means `private`.

from.description: First day of the window, inclusive.

to.description: Last day of the window, inclusive.

window.description: The period the PR history was mined over.

provider.description: The repository has no GitHub remote.

label.description: A display name the user chose for the repository.

from.description: First day of the window, inclusive.

to.description: Last day of the window, inclusive.

scope.description: The repository the report is about, and its window.

mergedPrs.description: Merged PRs in `scope.window` that the agent mined.

reviewComments.description: Total review comments on those PRs: every PR comment mined, whether or not it became a rule.

agentAssistedPrs.description: Of `mergedPrs`, those an AI agent helped write.

ruleShaped.description: Recurring review patterns a rule can enforce.

judgment.description: Recurring review patterns that need human judgment, so no rule was proposed.

patterns.description: Recurring patterns the agent found in the review comments.

history.description: The PR history the agent mined from GitHub over `scope.window`. Absent when it could not mine GitHub.

violations.description: Total `violations` across every written rule, at publish. Must equal the sum of the rules' `violations`.

files.description: Distinct files with at least one violation of any rule, at publish. A file breaking three rules counts once, so it lies between the largest rule's `files` and the sum of all rules' `files`.

findings.description: What `taskless check` found in the repository's code at publish, across every written rule. Present exactly when every written rule carries `violations` and `files`.

id.description: The rule's id, unique within the report.

title.description: What the rule enforces, in one line, scrubbed by the CLI.

explain.description: Optional plain prose from the agent on how the rule improves this codebase: what goes wrong without it, and what holding it buys. Scrubbed by the CLI, like `title`.

tier.description: Where the rule runs: `cli` on the Taskless CLI (sg, vale), `cloud` on Taskless Cloud (runtime), `legacy` in a quality tool the repository already ran, written by the agent during this work.

engine.description: The Taskless engine the rule runs on. Required for `cli` (sg or vale) and `cloud` (runtime) rules; absent on `legacy` rules.

tool.description: The quality tool a `legacy` rule was written for (such as `eslint`), as an identifier. Only on `legacy` rules.

language.description: The language the rule checks, as display text (`TypeScript`).

state.description: `written`: the rule exists in the repository and runs. `candidate`: a rule Taskless Cloud could write but has not; only in the `cloud` tier, and it carries `estimatedViolations` in place of `violations` and `files`. A candidate is never counted as a rule.

violations.description: Times this rule matched the repository's code when the report was published: the rule's hits from `taskless check` (or, for a legacy rule, from its tool), at publish. Not history. Present on every written rule exactly when the report has `findings`.

files.description: Files with at least one of this rule's `violations`, at publish. A count, never paths. At most `violations`, and 0 exactly when `violations` is 0.

estimatedViolations.description: A Cloud candidate's estimate of how many instances of its pattern are in the repository's code at publish, made by the agent that proposed it. An estimate, not a measurement: no rule has run. Required on every candidate and absent on written rules, which carry the measured `violations` instead.

prs.description: Merged PRs in `scope.window` whose review raised this rule's pattern, from the mined PR history.

reviewComments.description: Review comments in those PRs that asked for this rule's pattern, within `scope.window`, from the mined PR history.

surfaced.description: How often reviewers raised this rule's pattern in `scope.window`: what the rule saves reviewers. Requires `history`.

status.description: The result of running the rule's tests at publish: `pass` (both examples behave), `fail`, `refused` (the engine would not run them), or `not-run`.

code.description: The example's source code, scrubbed by the CLI.

fail.description: An example the rule flags, or null when there is none or it was withheld (see `withheld`).

code.description: The example's source code, scrubbed by the CLI.

pass.description: An example the rule accepts, or null when there is none or it was withheld (see `withheld`).

withheld.description: Examples the CLI withheld because it could not scrub them; each listed example is null.

tests.description: The rule's tests and their two examples.

rules.description: Every rule the report covers, written rules and candidates.

policyVersion.description: The version of the CLI scrubbing policy applied.

counts.description: Values the CLI scrubbed from rule titles, explanations and examples, by kind.

withheldFixtures.description: Examples withheld across all rules; equals the total of the rules' `tests.withheld`.

redaction.description: What the CLI scrubbed before the report left the machine.

title: ReportV1
description: A Taskless Report, as a CLI publishes it to tskl.es. Every object rejects unknown keys.

rules.title: Call the API through the shared apiClient
rules.explain: Direct fetch calls skip the retry, auth refresh and error mapping the client adds, so each one fails differently when the session expires.

body.url: The report on tskl.es. Anyone with it can view it.
body.deleteUrl: The only way to delete the report before it expires. Returned once, here.
body.expiresAt: 30 days after publishing, or 183 for public retention.

validation_error.description: The body is not JSON, fails the schema, or fails a consistency check; `details` names each failure. Not retryable as sent.

payload_too_large.description: The body is larger than `maxBytes`, by its declared length or the bytes read. Refused before parsing.

rate_limited.description: Too many publishes from this address. Retry after a minute.

publish_failed.description: The report was valid but could not be rendered or stored. Nothing was published: retry. Retry only on this error, never after a timeout, which may still publish.

response.body: None. The report, its JSON and its card are deleted; caches may keep serving them for up to a day.

not_available.description: No report answers to this key or delete token: it was never issued, was deleted, expired, or has not propagated yet. Not retryable.
